_comment: Ship daily operating costs (the 'burn'), in credits. Deducted once per in-game day (see advanceDay). The quantum singularity core (QSC-9) uses NO consumable fuel, so there's no fuel line. Each line has a checkbox in the Ship Ops panel: checked = active/billed, unchecked = you stop paying (and stop getting it). 'warn' is the hover tooltip that tells the player what unchecking costs them. Tune freely - no rebuild; the Ship Ops panel reads these live. Order here is the display order.

life_support.label: Life support & provisions
life_support.warn: Air, water, food, heat. You and Clara can't live without it - cutting this is not survivable for long.

qsc_containment.label: QSC-9 containment upkeep
qsc_containment.warn: Coolant and containment consumables for the singularity core. Skip it and containment integrity starts to degrade - the one system Clara can't afford to lose.

maintenance.label: Hull & systems maintenance
maintenance.warn: Spare parts and routine repair. Defer it and hull and systems wear out and fail faster.

clara_service.label: Android upkeep + Aether Dynamics service
clara_service.warn: Clara's maintenance contract, parts, and calibration. Let it lapse and her performance degrades over time.

data_subscriptions.label: Nav & comms relay (charts + external link)
data_subscriptions.warn: Your live link to the galactic network: current charts, beacons, and off-ship comms. Drop it and you're flying on stale cached charts and deaf to outside signals - adrift.

archive_subscription.label: Aether Dynamics data archives
archive_subscription.warn: Premium reference data: species IDs, geo-profiles, and the anomaly baseline. Drop it and scans come back as raw, unclassified readings.
